test_sink_batches: test the sink_batches method that splits a lazy frame into batches and appends each to a list for both in-memory and streaming engines
test_sink_batches_early_stop: test the sink_batches method with an early-stop callback that returns True to halt batch processing after the first chunk
test_collect_batches: test the collect_batches method that iterates over lazy frame batches and concatenates them back into the original dataframe
test_chunk_size: test the collect_batches method with a custom chunk_size parameter to verify each yielded batch matches the expected size
test_collect_batches_releases_gil: test that collect_batches with streaming engine correctly handles reentrant GIL release during nested map_elements operations
